name: Niroso
description: Stone elementals created during the Brothers' War, lured by the sorceress Sacumon to start a war and creators of the coal golems.

description_citations.text: "Elemental". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sorceress Sacumon lures the Niroso to start a war between the minotaurs of Urhaalan Valley and the elves of Eln Forest.
timeline.quote: They were lured by the sorceress Sacumon to instigate a war between the minotaurs of Urhaalan Valley and elves of Eln Forest during the Dark Age .

citation.text: "Elemental", section "Niroso". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Niroso build the coal golems from coal deposits as shock troops.
timeline.quote: They were also the creators of the coal golems, which they built from coal deposits in the earth using magic.
